title: Proper closed bound for supports of a bounded tensor
statement: Let f:X -> S be a locally finite-type scheme morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let E be any object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and let G be a bounded complex of O_X-modules whose every term has support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. There exists a closed subset Z of X proper over S such that for every integer i the nonzero-stalk locus of H^i(E tensor^L G) [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] is contained in Z. This does not assert that these cohomology supports are closed. No perfection, coherence, relative flatness or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: 0DJQ: support hypothesis in the application of 08EV; 01AT; 09MQ (4); 03GN

proof.text: If [c,d] bounds G, let Z be the union of the supports of G^n for c <= n <= d. Terms outside the interval are zero, with empty support. This is a finite union of closed subsets. If c > d the entire complex is zero and the union is empty.

source.place: 0DJQ: support hypothesis in the application of 08EV; 01AT; 09MQ (4); 03GN

proof.text: Each reduced term support maps by a closed immersion into the reduced union Z. The finite disjoint union of these supports therefore maps properly and surjectively to Z. Its map to S is proper by the assumed properness of every term support. Separatedness of Z over S descends along this proper surjection (09MQ (4)), and universal closedness descends by 03GN. Local finite type follows from Z being a closed subscheme of X. These three properties make Z proper over S.

source.place: 0DJQ: support hypothesis in the application of 08EV; 01AT; 09MQ (4); 03GN

proof.text: On the open complement of Z every term of G has zero stalks, hence is the zero sheaf. Therefore the restricted complex G is zero. Restriction to an open commutes with the K-flat derived tensor, and tensor with zero is zero, so E tensor^L G restricts to zero there, for arbitrary E. Exactness of open restriction shows every cohomology sheaf is zero on this complement. Its nonzero-stalk locus is consequently contained in Z, as asserted. For an empty Z the same proof gives zero cohomology everywhere.

lean.statement:
theorem boundedComplex_tensor_proper_support_bound
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hGb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    (hGproper : ∀ n : ℤ, Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.X n)) :
    ∃ Z : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X, IsClosedSubsetProperOver f Z ∧
      ∀ i : ℤ,
        {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton
          ((Modules.presheaf (X := X)
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj
                (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G))).stalk x)} ⊆ (Z : Set X)
